Method of Attack: Encrypts files smaller than 2,117,152 bytes with AES-256 (CBC-SALTED) and appends 'fuckazov' file extension
Fills files larger than 2,117,152 bytes with random data making recovery impossible without backup
Impacted Systems: Files on all drives including \Desktop, \Links, \Contacts, \Documents, \Downloads, \Pictures, \Music, \OneDrive, \Saved Games, \Favorites, \Searches, and \Videos directories
Attack Vector: GUI-based ransomware builder to customize the malware
Likely arrives via forum posts or emails focused on the current Russia-Ukraine war
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of 'stop_propaganda.txt' with political messages and no ransom demand
Encrypted files with RSA encrypted password and base64 encoded AES encrypted file content
